children: Indivior declared a special cash dividend of $8.13 per share contingent on closing its merger with Supernus.
Board declared a special cash dividend of $8.13 per share payable to holders of record on Oct 30, 2026.
Equity awards outstanding on the record date receive $8.13 per share upon vesting to award holders.
Payment is conditioned on closing the Merger with Supernus, expected on or about Nov 2, 2026; payment anticipated ~Nov 6, 2026.
Indivior expects a majority of the Special Dividend to exceed current and accumulated earnings and profits; U.S. tax treatment may be return of capital then capital gain.
